replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
Your map has been denied from the Map Developers for the following reasons. 

-Too small: It does not look like it can hold the amount of players it is intended to hold.

-Core places: Seem in an awkward area. Try to find an area that makes it easy to defend but also possible to get after a few minutes.

-Aesthetics: The block palette needs to be a bit more than what it is now.

You may submit the map after these edits are made.
